input.title: Use PUBLIC_URL from environment instead of hardcoded localhost in password reset email
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The `BASE_URL` is hardcoded to `http://localhost:3000` when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes password reset emails to link to `localhost`, which is unusable in production or remote environments. The fix should rely solely on `process.env.PUBLIC_URL`, removing the fallback to `localhost` entirely, to ensure the correct URL is used in all environments.
